analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW — September 8, 2026

MARKET REGIME: SPY in uptrend (+1.8% vs SMA50, 20d slope positive). Constructive backdrop, but that alone does not justify forcing trades.

CRITICAL CONCENTRATION ALERT — AMP: At $30,831, AMP represents ~30.9% of total equity, materially breaching the 25% hard cap ($24,955 limit). This is the single most important risk item in the book. The position has gained +3.65% which is good, but concentration risk now dominates. Recommend trimming approximately 11-12 shares (~$6,200 worth) outside this cycle's formal trade list to bring AMP back to ~24% of equity. This is a maintenance action, not a thesis call.

IDXX THESIS REVIEW: IDXX is down -4.14% and does NOT appear on the current screened candidate list, indicating it likely failed the 'no confirmed downtrend' filter. This is a material thesis-break signal. The position should be reviewed against its original stop-loss level. If the stop has not been hit, hold per plan, but the absence from the screened universe warrants heightened vigilance and a tighter leash.

AON (-0.57%), MCO (+4.75%), ROP (-1.28%), RMD (+0.91%): ROP and RMD both remain on the screened list in uptrend/basing mode, so their theses appear intact. AON and MCO are not on the screened list but drawdowns are modest; monitor stops.

NEW BUYS: Remaining headroom is $425 — effectively zero capacity for any new position. Even if we identified a perfect setup (SCHW, APH, and ANET are highest-quality momentum setups; IT and CVNA are attractive basing setups with good fundamentals), there is no room to size properly. Forcing a $425 allocation would be a rounding error that adds transaction cost and complexity without meaningful exposure. The capacity constraint alone rules out all new buys this cycle.

PERFORMANCE HONESTY: Win rate 11.1%, profit factor 0.05x, Sortino -6.50. The system has not demonstrated stock-picking edge. Preserving the remaining ~$99.8k and letting current positions either work or stop out is the correct stance. No manufactured alpha this cycle. Cash discipline is the only alpha available.

RECOMMENDATION: Zero new trades. Primary action is to trim AMP concentration (discuss with broker, not captured as a screened-list trade). Monitor IDXX against its stop. Hold RMD and ROP as both remain valid candidates. Review AON and MCO stops proactively.
